channel.title: Holy City Sinner - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Hamby Catering & Events Named Best Catered Event of 2026 by the International Caterers
item.description: Hamby Catering & Events has received national recognition from the International Caterers Association (ICA), winning Best Catered Wedding at the prestigious Catered Arts Through Innovative Excellence (CATIE) Awards.

item.title: Fu-O BBQ Launches Lunch Service + Happy Hour Deals in Nexton
item.description: Fu-O BBQ, the brand-new Japanese BBQ restaurant in Downtown Nexton known for its interactive tableside grilling experience, has expanded its hours with a new lunch program and happy hour deals.

item.title: Trident United Way Recognized in Charleston Business Magazine’s Inaugural Excellence in Nonprofit Awards
item.description: Trident United Way has been recognized in the Large Nonprofit Organization category (organizations with operating budgets of $5 million or more) in the inaugural Charleston Business Magazine Excellence in Nonprofit Awards

item.title: Charleston County accepting applications for annual Summer Youth Internship Program
item.description: Charleston County Government is now accepting applications for the 2026 Summer Youth Internship Program.

item.title: Father’s Day Gifts Beyond the Tie at M. Dumas and Sons
item.description: This Father’s Day, M. Dumas and Sons is offering gift ideas that go well beyond the predictable tie or coffee mug.

item.title: Bojangles Announces Daylight Savings Promo
item.description: To celebrate Daylight Savings this weekend, Bojangles is offering fans a way to make up for that lost hour of sleep. This weekend, fans can get a FREE Iced Coffee (in French Vanilla or Caramel) with their purchase of $5 or more.

item.title: City of Charleston Celebrates International Open Data Day
item.description: On Friday, the City of Charleston joined governments around the world in celebrating International Open Data Day — a global initiative promoting transparency, accessibility, and the power of public data.

item.title: Picnic for the Parks Tickets Now Available
item.description: Tickets are now available for the Charleston Parks Conservancy’s sixth annual Picnic for the Parks, presented by Biom, a spring afternoon that brings families together in one of the city’s most iconic parks.

item.title: Redux Announces Exhibitions by Riivo Kruuk and Melissa Callaway
item.description: Redux Contemporary Art Center announced the opening of three new exhibitions by local artist Riivo Kruuk, Redux Studio Artist Melissa Callaway, and Lightning Resident’s Lauren Ronald and Zach Higgins.

item.title: Berkeley Animal Shelter Construction Impacting Animal Adoptions
item.description: Adoption floor improvements are coming to Charleston Animal Society's Berkeley Campus. However, the upgrade will create short-term space issues that could impact adoptions without the public's help.
